name: Almeda Mall
summary: Casual indoor shopping plaza with department stores, eateries &  clothing, footwear & jewelry shops.
demographics: Almeda Mall primarily serves the diverse, multicultural communities of southeast Houston, attracting middle-income families and value-conscious shoppers from surrounding neighborhoods. The trade area encompasses a predominantly Hispanic and African American demographic with household incomes ranging from lower-middle to middle class, including young families and multi-generational households. Visitors typically seek affordable fashion, family-oriented retail options, and convenient one-stop shopping experiences, with strong weekend traffic from families looking for both shopping and entertainment activities.
description: Almeda Mall is a distinctive shopping destination located at 12200 Gulf Freeway in Houston, Texas, offering a comprehensive retail experience for the diverse communities of southeast Houston. This enclosed regional mall provides visitors with an extensive selection of top brands and stores catering to every member of the family, whether you're an outdoorsman seeking adventure gear or an urbanite looking for the latest fashion trends. The center features a vibrant food court with a great selection of restaurants offering delicious dining options to fuel your shopping experience. Beyond retail therapy, Almeda Mall serves as a community gathering place with entertainment options and activities ensuring there's something fun to do for visitors of all interests. With its convenient location along the Gulf Freeway and ample amenities, Almeda Mall has established itself as a go-to retail destination for Houston-area shoppers seeking variety, value, and an engaging shopping environment.
